signIn.title: Sign in to Quizz
signIn.intro: Build Assessments and issue verifiable Certificates under your own brand.

signIn.failed: We couldn't send the link. Try again in a minute.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Your Certificates carry this name and branding.
settings.name: Creator name
settings.imageHint: Images: PNG or JPEG, up to 2 MB.

errors.invalid: Enter a Creator name and pick an accent colour.
errors.badImage: Images must be PNG or JPEG.
errors.tooLarge: Images must be 2 MB or smaller.

magicLink.subject: Your Quizz sign-in link

editor.noQuestions: No Questions yet. Add the first one.
editor.question: Question {n}
editor.insertImage: Insert image (PNG or JPEG, up to 2 MB)

imageErrors.badImage: Images must be PNG or JPEG.
imageErrors.tooLarge: Images must be 2 MB or smaller.

problems.tooFewOptions: Give at least two answer options.
problems.emptyOption: Fill in or remove empty options.
problems.tooManyCorrect: Only one option can be correct.

save.failed: Couldn't save. Check your connection and edit again.

editor.keptOrder: Options are shown in this order.
editor.shuffled: Options are shuffled for each Learner.
editor.imported: Imported {n, plural, one {# Question} other {# Questions}}.
editor.importRejected: Nothing was imported. Fix these rows and import the file again:

importErrors.badHeader: The header must name the columns type, question, option_1…option_8, correct and keep_order.
importErrors.tooLarge: The file must be 1 MB or smaller.
importErrors.badType: type must be single, multi or truefalse.
importErrors.badCorrect: correct must name filled options, like 1;3, or be true or false for true/false.
importErrors.badKeepOrder: keep_order must be yes or blank.
importErrors.tooManyOptions: More values than columns: at most 8 options.

settingsTabs.invalid: Some values are out of range. Check them and save again.

rules.drawnHint: Drawn at random from the {n} in the Question Pool.
rules.timeLimitHint: Not submitted in time = Timed out, no score.
rules.maxAttemptsHint: Retake Policy. Starts again when a Certificate expires.
rules.expiryHint: Certificates show as expired after this.

access.languageHint: The language Learners see this Assessment and its Certificates in.
access.invited: {n, plural, =0 {Nobody invited yet} one {# email invited} other {# emails invited}}
access.invitesHint: Paste emails separated by spaces, commas or new lines. Only their keyed hashes are stored, so the list can't be shown; paste an email again to remove it. Quizz sends no invitations: share the link yourself. Changes apply at once.
access.added: {n, plural, =0 {No new emails invited.} one {# email invited.} other {# emails invited.}}
access.removed: {n, plural, =0 {None of these were invited.} one {# email removed.} other {# emails removed.}}
access.skipped: {n, plural, one {# entry isn't an email and was skipped.} other {# entries aren't emails and were skipped.}}

publishTab.draftHint: Publishing freezes Version 1 and opens the Assessment to Learners.

problems.poolTooSmall: The Question Pool has {pool, plural, one {# Question} other {# Questions}} but each Attempt draws {drawn}. Add more or draw fewer on the Rules tab.
problems.noPassingScore: Set a Passing Score on the Rules tab.
problems.noTimeLimit: Set a time limit on the Rules tab.
problems.noBranding: Finish your Certificate branding in Settings: {missing}.

publishTab.closedHint: Closed: no new Attempts. Certificates stay valid.
publishTab.confirmDelete: Delete this Draft and its Questions?
publishTab.noDelete: A published Assessment can't be deleted, only Closed.
